text:
maria: Heads-up: customers keep pinging about canary spikes. Warmup/prefetch tokens are inflating per-model burn on the dashboard (~120k for one rollout).

mike: We tag those invocations (`is_warmup`) but the heatmap sums total_tokens so they show up in model rows.

ash: UX ask: add a heatmap toggle to exclude warmup and a small "Estimated warmup" line in rollout preview. PMs need better visibility.

tanvi: Telemetry can emit `cache_origin_route` and `warmup_group` so we can produce both raw and credited views. Caveat: more metadata increases volume; we should sample synthetic probes.

mike: Backend plan: produce model_tokens_total and model_tokens_excluding_warmup rollups. Add console API flag `?include_warmup=true|false` and a preview endpoint for rollouts that returns estimated warmup tokens/cost.

ash: Tooltip copy idea: "Warmup tokens are system-initiated prefetches and probes performed when routing to cold variants. They are billable but shown separately to avoid misleading comparisons." Short + long ready.

billing-bot: Created ticket RW-6001: "dashboard warmup split + route crediting" (assignee: unassigned)

maria: Owners: mike backend, tanvi telemetry, ash UX. Will attach a quick mock and the SQL preview in RW-6001. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
